purpose: Lightweight routing + output-contract fixtures. These are specs, not executed against a live model in CI. tests/test_routing_fixtures.py validates that each fixture is well-formed and routes to a skill this plugin ships (or 'none'); they also serve as worked examples of when deep-research is (and is NOT) the right skill, and what its output must contain.

fixtures.request: Write a thorough, cited report on the state of solid-state battery commercialization in 2026 — the key players, expected timelines, and the remaining technical barriers.

expected_routing.reason: Open-ended multi-source synthesis into a single cited report. Not a recurring digest and not a dossier on one named entity.

required_output_fields: evidence-basis tags ([VERIFIED]/[SOURCED]/[REASONED]/[ESTIMATED]) with an evidence key

fixtures.request: Is it true that more than half of new cars sold in Norway in 2025 were fully electric? Check this and show your sources.

expected_routing.reason: This plugin ships no dedicated fact-checker: a single claim to verify is deep-research's fact-check report category at simple complexity (plan → search both sides → verdict), not a recurring digest.

required_output_fields: evidence-basis tags ([VERIFIED]/[SOURCED]/[REASONED]/[ESTIMATED]) with an evidence key

fixtures.request: Give me a background dossier on Acme Robotics Ltd — who owns it, any adverse media, and whether it has sanctions exposure.

expected_routing.reason: Background/vetting of one named entity with ownership, adverse-media and sanctions signals is entity-research, not a general research report.

fixtures.request: I'm going to paste five PDFs. Answer my questions strictly from those documents, with quotes, and tell me when they don't cover something.

expected_routing.reason: Strictly-grounded Q&A over user-supplied documents needs no Chief-of-Staff skill: answer directly from the documents with quotes. deep-research researches the open web.
